```{python}
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, ".")
import pandas as pd
from _helpers import fig, table, single, flat_table, read_flat, read_family_map, say
```

This page counts transcription factors (TFs) in the BFD genomes. A TF here is a protein with at least one DNA-binding domain from a fixed list of Pfam families. The list is the family map shown at the end of this page.

::: {.callout-warning}
## Definition and limits
- **Pfam-based.** A protein is a TF when it has a hit to a listed Pfam model. This is a domain call, not proof of function. A protein can have a TF domain and not act as a TF.
- **distinct proteins.** All counts are distinct proteins. A protein with two TF domains is counted once for the genome and once for each family it belongs to. The unit is the protein-coding gene products of a genome (protein-coding genes with a proteome).
- **TF fraction** = proteins with a TF domain divided by all proteins of the genome.
- Genomes with no proteome are not plotted. Genomes with no TF protein have no composition and no Shannon index (NaN, not 0).
- The group tests have no phylogenetic control. Read the effect sizes as descriptions of the sample.
:::

## Scope

```{python}
t = read_flat("T_tf_groups", "phylum")
if t is None:
    say("*The TF group table has not been built yet, so the counts for this page are not shown.*")
else:
    n, nproteome, ntf = int(t["n_genomes"].sum()), int(t["n_with_proteome"].sum()), int(t["n_with_tf"].sum())
    say(f"One representative genome per species. The phylum table lists {n:,} representative genomes in {len(t)} groups. "
        f"{nproteome:,} have a proteome and {ntf:,} have at least one TF protein. "
        "The counts are read from the tables of this build when the page renders.")
```

## Group summaries

The group table gives, for each group, the genome count, the count with a proteome, the count with a TF protein and the group medians.

```{python}
table("T_tf_groups", digits=4)
```

The tests compare the groups of each level for the TF fraction and the Shannon index. The columns are the effect size and the adjusted p-value of the group test. There is no phylogenetic control.

```{python}
table("T_anova_tf", digits=4)
```

## The TF family map

The map links each Pfam accession to a BFD family label and to a row of the family table of Lax et al. 2025 (Nature Communications 16:10277; the paper's families come from InterPro, not from Pfam). The page reads the map from `data/tf_family_map.tsv`. This file is a copy of `config/tf_family_map.tsv`. A test checks that the two files are the same.

```{python}
fm = read_family_map()
if fm is None:
    say("*The family map `data/tf_family_map.tsv` could not be read, so the counts and tables of this section are not shown.*")
else:
    counted = fm[fm["pfam_acc"] != ""]
    bfd_fam = counted["family"].nunique()
    paper_mapped = counted.loc[counted["paper_family"] != "", "paper_family"].nunique()
    unmapped = fm[(fm["pfam_acc"] == "") & (fm["paper_family"] != "") & fm["note"].str.startswith("unmapped")]
    bact = fm[(fm["pfam_acc"] == "") & fm["note"].str.startswith("not fungal")]
    say(f"The map has {len(counted)} Pfam accessions. They give {bfd_fam} distinct BFD family labels and cover "
        f"{paper_mapped} paper family rows. The map lists {len(unmapped)} further paper families with no Pfam in the map "
        f"(unmapped) and {len(bact)} bacterial paper families (not fungal). These numbers are read from the map.")
```

### Caveats

- **STAT is not detectable.** The Pfam STAT models (PF01017, PF02864, PF21354) hit very few BFD genomes (the map notes give the count). The paper's table has STAT in many more species. This is a difference in definition, not a result. The claims page shows it as "not comparable".
- **Paper families with no Pfam in the map are not counted.** The list is the table of unmapped paper families below. The pipeline's old Pfam rows for SBP and WOPR are also not counted (see the corrections table).
- **The paper's counts are InterPro-based.** BFD counts come from Pfam. The calibration on the claims page compares them for the species that both sets share.
- **Some paper families are wider than the Pfam that maps to them.** For example, HTH/Homeodomain-like is wider than Pfam Homeodomain.
- **The histone-fold family (CBFD_NFYB_HMF) is an upper bound.** The domain is also in histone-fold proteins that are not CBF/NF-Y TFs.
- **Pfam release.** The map was checked against Pfam 38.2.

### Corrections to the pipeline's TF Pfam list

Five rows of the TF Pfam CSV that the pipeline used (`nextflow/assets/fungal_tf_pfam_domains.csv`) disagree with Pfam 38.2. The BFD list in the map corrects them.

| Accession in the CSV | CSV label | Name in Pfam 38.2 | Treatment in the BFD list |
|---|---|---|---|
| PF00446 | SBP | GnRH | not counted; SBP is PF03110 (a plant-type domain; the map notes give its BFD hit count) |
| PF11955 | WOPR | PORR | not counted; Pfam 38.2 has no WOPR model |
| PF04844 | APSES | Ovate (a plant family) | not counted; APSES is covered by PF04383 (KilA-N) |
| PF11951 | C6H2-type zinc finger | Fungal_trans_2 | counted as Fungal_trans_2, not as a zinc finger |
| PF08880 | Rrn7-type RNA Pol I TF | QLQ | excluded; QLQ is not a TF DNA-binding domain |

### Pfam families and their paper family

```{python}
if fm is None:
    say("*Family map not available.*")
else:
    cols = ["pfam_acc", "pfam_id", "family", "paper_family"]
    say(counted[cols].to_markdown(index=False))
```

### Paper families with no Pfam in the map (unmapped)

```{python}
if fm is None:
    say("*Family map not available.*")
else:
    u = unmapped[["paper_family", "note"]]
    say(u.to_markdown(index=False) if len(u) else "No unmapped paper families are listed.")
```

### Notes on the rows that are not counted

```{python}
if fm is None:
    say("*Family map not available.*")
else:
    other = fm[(fm["pfam_acc"] == "") & (fm["paper_family"] == "")][["note"]]
    say(other.to_markdown(index=False) if len(other) else "No such rows.")
```
